items.source: While this FactoryBean will often be used for singleton targets, the invoked getters for the property path might return a new object for each call, so we have to assume that we're not returning the same object for each getObject() call.
items.translation: 虽然此 FactoryBean 通常用于单例目标，但针对属性路径调用的 getter 可能会为每次调用返回一个新对象，因此我们必须假设我们不会为每个 `getObject()` 调用返回同一个对象。

items.source: The target object can be specified directly or via a bean name.
items.translation: 目标对象可以直接指定或通过 Bean 名称指定。

items.source: Usage examples:
items.translation: 使用示例：

items.source:
If you are using Spring 2.0 and XML Schema support in your configuration file(s),
you can also use the following style of configuration for property path access.
(See also the appendix entitled 'XML Schema-based configuration' in the Spring
reference manual for more examples.)
items.translation: 如果您在配置文件中使用了 Spring 2.0 和 XML Schema 支持，也可以使用以下风格的配置来访问属性路径。（另请参阅 Spring 参考手册中题为“基于 XML Schema 的配置”的附录以获取更多示例。）

items.source:
Note: This is not necessary for directly specified target objects
or singleton target beans, where the type can be determined through
introspection. Just specify this in case of a prototype target,
provided that you need matching by type (for example, for autowiring).
items.translation: 注意：对于直接指定的目标对象或单例目标 Bean，由于可以通过内省确定其类型，因此不需要这样做。仅在原型目标的情况下指定此项（例如用于自动装配），前提是您需要按类型进行匹配。

items.source: Specify the property path to apply to the target.
items.translation: 指定要应用于目标的属性路径。

items.source:
Specify a target object to apply the property path to.
Alternatively, specify a target bean name.
items.translation: 指定要应用属性路径的目标对象。或者，指定目标 Bean 名称。

items.source:
Specify the name of a target bean to apply the property path to.
Alternatively, specify a target object directly.
items.translation: 指定要应用属性路径的目标 Bean 名称。或者，直接指定目标对象。

items.source:
The bean name of this PropertyPathFactoryBean will be interpreted
as "beanName.property" pattern, if neither "targetObject" nor
"targetBeanName" nor "propertyPath" have been specified.
This allows for concise bean definitions with just an id/name.
items.translation: 如果未指定"targetObject"、"targetBeanName"或"propertyPath"，此 PropertyPathFactoryBean 的 Bean 名称将被解释为"beanName.property"模式。这允许仅使用 id/名称即可定义简洁的 Bean 定义。

items.source: targetObject - a target object, for example a bean reference or an inner bean
items.translation: targetObject - 目标对象，例如 Bean 引用或内部 Bean

items.source: targetBeanName - the bean name to be looked up in the containing bean factory (for example, "testBean")
items.translation: targetBeanName - 要在包含的 Bean 工厂中查找的 Bean 名称（例如，"testBean"）

items.source: propertyPath - the property path, potentially nested (for example, "age" or "spouse.age")
items.translation: propertyPath - 属性路径，可能为嵌套路径（例如，"age"或"spouse.age"）

items.source: resultType - the result type, for example "java.lang.Integer"
items.translation: resultType - 结果类型，例如 "java.lang.Integer"

items.source: FactoryBeans are allowed to return null objects. The bean factory will consider this as a normal value to be used and will not throw a FactoryBeanNotInitializedException in this case. However, FactoryBean implementations are encouraged to throw FactoryBeanNotInitializedException themselves, as appropriate.
items.translation: FactoryBeans 允许返回 `null` 对象。在此情况下，Bean 工厂会将其视为正常值并使用该值，而不会抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。不过，建议 FactoryBean 实现类根据具体情况自行抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后，但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

items.source: As with a BeanFactory, this allows support for both the Singleton and Prototype design patterns.
items.translation: 与BeanFactory一样，它支持单例和原型这两种设计模式。

items.source: If this FactoryBean is not fully initialized yet at the time of the call (for example because it is involved in a circular reference), throw a corresponding FactoryBeanNotInitializedException.
items.translation: 如果在此调用时该 FactoryBean 尚未完全初始化（例如因为它涉及循环引用），则抛出相应的FactoryBeanNotInitializedException。

items.source: NOTE: Autowiring will simply ignore FactoryBeans that return null here. Therefore, it is highly recommended to implement this method properly, using the current state of the FactoryBean.
items.translation: 注意： 自动装配将简单地忽略在此处返回`null`的 FactoryBean。因此，强烈建议使用 FactoryBean 的当前状态正确实现此方法。

items.source: This method can be called before this FactoryBean has been fully initialized. It must not rely on state created during initialization; of course, it can still use such state if available.
items.translation: 此方法可以在该 FactoryBean 完全初始化之前被调用。它不能依赖在初始化期间创建的状态；当然，如果可用，它仍然可以使用此类状态。

items.source:
This allows one to check for specific types of beans without
instantiating objects, for example on autowiring.
items.translation: 这允许在例如自动装配时，无需实例化对象即可检查特定类型的 Bean。

items.source:
In the case of implementations that create a singleton object,
this method should try to avoid singleton creation as far as possible;
it should rather estimate the type in advance.
For prototypes, returning a meaningful type here is advisable too.
items.translation: 对于创建单例对象的实现，此方法应尽可能避免创建单例；相反，它应预先估算类型。对于原型对象，在此处返回有意义的类型也是可取的。

items.translation: 返回此 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如果无法预先确定则返回 `null`。

items.source:
Return an instance (possibly shared or independent) of the object
managed by this factory.
items.translation: 返回由该工厂管理的对象的实例（可能是共享的或独立的）。

items.source: Callback that supplies the owning factory to a bean instance.
items.translation: 向 Bean 实例提供其所属工厂的回调。

items.translation: 如果未指定“targetObject”、“targetBeanName”或“propertyPath”，则该 PropertyPathFactoryBean 的 bean 名称将被解释为“beanName.property”模式。

items.source: Specify the type of the result from evaluating the property path.
items.translation: 指定评估属性路径后结果结果的类型。

items.source: Specify the name of a target bean to apply the property path to.
items.translation: 指定要应用属性路径的目标 Bean 的名称。

items.translation: 指定目标对象以应用属性路径。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean in the factory. Note that this name is the actual bean name used in the factory, which may differ from the originally specified name: in particular for inner bean names, the actual bean name might have been made unique through appending "#..." suffixes. Use the BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String) method to extract the original bean name (without suffix), if desired.
items.translation: beanName - 工厂中 Bean 的名称。请注意，此名称是工厂中实际使用的 Bean 名称，可能与最初指定的名称不同：特别是对于内部 Bean 名称，实际 Bean 名称可能已通过追加"#..."后缀使其唯一化。如需提取原始 Bean 名称（不带后缀），请使用BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String)方法。

items.source: beanFactory - owning BeanFactory (never null). The bean can immediately call methods on the factory.
items.translation: beanFactory - 拥有该 Bean 的 BeanFactory（永远不会为 null）。 该 Bean 可以立即调用工厂上的方法。

items.source: an instance of the bean (can be null)
items.translation: bean 的实例（可以为null）

items.translation: 该 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，或在调用时未知则为 `null`。
